context: Daichi was transferred from the Osaka branch. Kenji is showing him around the Tokyo office on his first day.
purpose: colleague onboarding across regional culture — first day kindness over coffee

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 大阪から、お疲れさまでした。
lines.en: You came all the way from Osaka — good work.
lines.style: Earnest salaryman warm welcome, the formal courtesy held with real consideration, soft sincere greeting throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: いえいえ、こちらこそ、よろしゅう頼みます。
lines.en: No no, please look out for me too.
lines.style: Kansai warm humble swing, the regional ending charming the formality, soft real openness threading through warmly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 同期は、私の他にもう一人います。
lines.en: Besides me, there's one more from our cohort.
lines.style: Earnest salaryman helpful information sharing, the professional cadence steady, soft welcoming warmth held throughout.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ほな、いろいろ教えてもろて、助かりますわ。
lines.en: Then, getting taught lots of things will really help.
lines.style: Kansai casual gratitude, regional dialect warming the standard courtesy, real appreciation soft and unforced throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 配属はマーケティング部ですよね。
lines.style: Salaryman confirming polite, the casual check carrying real professional attention, courteous warmth held steadily.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: そうですわ。緊張しますわ、正直。
lines.style: Kansai honest vulnerability under the regional swing, the dialect making the confession land easier and warmer.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 最初はみんなそうですよ。困ったら声かけてください。
lines.en: Everyone is at first. If you're stuck, just call out.
lines.style: Earnest salaryman warm reassurance, the steady experienced kindness threading through, soft real offer extended throughout.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: おおきに。ほんま助かります。
lines.style: Kansai deep regional gratitude, the dialect carrying the full weight of relief, soft real warmth throughout closing.
